metadata.title: Local unmarked length spectrum rigidity for hyperbolic surfaces
metadata.abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a closed negatively curved surface. If $g$ is strictly $\tfrac 19$-pinched and has the same unmarked length spectrum as a hyperbolic metric, we show that $g$ is hyperbolic. As a consequence, we show that any hyperbolic metric on a surface admits a $C^2$-neighborhood in the space of metrics in which it is characterized by its unmarked length spectrum, up to isometry.

analysis.progressType: 双曲曲面的无标记长度谱局部刚性
analysis.workSummary: 证明闭负曲率曲面若严格 1/9-pinched 且无标记长度谱与双曲度量相同，则本身双曲；推出每个双曲度量在 C² 邻域内由无标记长度谱确定至等距。
analysis.breakthrough: 在邻近双曲度量的情形，去除逐条闭测地线的标记数据。
analysis.limitations: 长度谱按重数计；严格 1/9-pinched 条件先推出双曲性，C² 邻域才进一步保证等距。已知存在不同但等长度谱的双曲曲面，不能省略局部范围。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。
